# Google Sources For This Skill

Use these sources in roughly this order.

## Primary sources

- Search Console property for this site: https://search.google.com/u/2/search-console?resource_id=sc-domain%3Amyrents-app.com
- Google Search Central SEO Starter Guide: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/seo-starter-guide
- Helpful, reliable, people-first content: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content
- Guidance on using generative AI content: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/using-gen-ai-content
- Title links guidance: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/title-link
- Snippet and meta description guidance: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/snippet
- Search Console impressions, clicks, and position: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7042828
- Search Console Page indexing report: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7440203
- Search Console Core Web Vitals report: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9205520
- Search Console Sitemaps report: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7451001
- PageSpeed Insights: https://pagespeed.web.dev/

## High-value support tools from Google

- Google Trends for demand and phrasing patterns: https://trends.google.com/
- Google Analytics 4 for behavior and engagement follow-up: https://analytics.google.com/
- Looker Studio for Search Console and GA4 dashboards: https://lookerstudio.google.com/
- Google Tag Manager only if measurement implementation changes are needed: https://tagmanager.google.com/
- Keyword Planner only when paid-search tooling is available and keyword estimates are genuinely needed: https://ads.google.com/home/tools/keyword-planner/

## Usually not primary for this repo

- Google Merchant Center: only relevant if My Rents later publishes commerce feeds or shopping listings.
- Google Business Profile: only relevant if local business discovery becomes a primary acquisition channel.

## Interpretation notes

- Search Console beats assumptions. Use property data first when it is available.
- Search Central docs beat third-party SEO folklore.
- Google explicitly advises against keyword stuffing, content made mainly for search engines, and scaled low-value AI content.
- The goal is stronger relevance, indexing health, page experience, and click appeal, not a guarantee of first position.
